name: A Process
description: Fig 1a — A process: typed input and output ports plus a configuration whose update method maps inputs to a delta over the outputs. The generic interface every mechanism conforms to.

contract.summary: A process — typed input/output ports + a configuration
contract.description: A process is a typed function signature: its update method maps a configuration and typed inputs to a delta Δ over its typed outputs — the tree of changes to apply, branched by output port. Wiring two processes is admissible only where their port types align.

symbols.\u0394: delta — the update applied to the stores
